Analysis.object: Teammates and the uniform pressure and self-concept of strength were associated with higher ED symptoms in female rowers, whereas better self-concept, psychological well-being and more age showed less susceptibility of ED symptoms.
The SCOFF scale should be complemented by other ED questionnaires to obtain more specific information regarding to ED psychopathology. Small size of the sample also may be a limitation.

More research is needed on the key protective/facilitating factors against the development of DE in order to tailor prevention and intervention programmes for athletes, coaches, parents and technical staff, and to ensure that sports policies include health professionals (psychologists, nutritionists of physiotherapists) who are aware of ED.

Population.object: Female fixed-bench rowers from all clubs, athletes participated on the two competitive levels allocated on the Cantabrian Sea
